title: Virtua Fighter Remix
overview:
Full screen re-mix of the AM2 classic also includes CG disc of VF2. This special edition, includes bigger characters re-created using the latest texture mapping technology, in addition the response time from the control pad has been increased.

Eight fighters, each with their own martial art, battle one-on-one in a 3D ring to become the ultimate champion. Use punch, kick and guard to build combinations and throws, and win each round by draining your opponent's energy, knocking them out of the ring or leading when time runs out.

- Fully texture-mapped fighters
- For 1 or 2 players
- Includes a bonus Virtua Fighter CD+G portrait disc
